newsitem.title: USA: Cable & Wireless begins Los Angeles service.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless begins Los Angeles service.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Inc, the U.S. unit of Cable & Wireless Plc, said on Thursday it began a combined local and long distance service for businesses in Los Angeles and the San Jose/Silicon Valley area of California.
The company already provides similar services in New York City, Connecticut and San Francisco, and has regulatory approval to do so in Maryland, Texas, Florida and Illinois.
The company said it was well placed to serve the market by offering a broad package of services on one bill and with one point of customer service.
